chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: What is extended replacement cost coverage?

chunks.text: Extended Replacement Cost provides an additional buffer (25% or 50% above your Coverage A Dwelling limit) if rebuilding costs exceed initial estimates due to surge inflation, rising material costs, or labor shortages following a major disaster.
